inputs.name: id
inputs.title: Project
inputs.description: GitLab project path (e.g., "my-group/my-project") or numeric ID

inputs.title: Title
inputs.description: New title for the merge request

inputs.name: description
inputs.title: Description
inputs.description: New description for the merge request

inputs.title: State event
inputs.description: New merge request state. Allowed values: close, reopen

inputs.name: targetBranch
inputs.title: Target branch
